Welcome to Weekly Tidbits by Markets by Zerodha, where we explore interesting stories from around the world that don't always make it into a full Daily Brief episode. In this edition, we cover 13 stories across Global, Economy, Industry and Company (GEIC), from HSBC's plans to expand its Singapore business and Nvidia's leadership developments to India's rising inflation, battery recycling push and Waaree's green ammonia ambitions.
